g.text: There's something I need to tell you.
When you arrived, I figured you were just another obstacle.
Ugh. I've been trying to figure out how to do this for *days* now.
Just more bullshit for me to overcome, like everything else in my life.
Are you breaking up with me...?
If you had told me, that day we first crossed swords... how you would go on to change my life?
What?! NO! How would that even --
No! No. Absolutely not. I'm just...shit at expressing this kind of thing.
That you'd save my life? That you'd save ALL our lives?!
When you arrived, I figured you were just another obstacle.
I'd have laughed in your sodding face.
I don't even want to know.
Just more bullshit for me to overcome, like everything else in my life.
...... I am *really trying* to have a serious moment here...
If you had told me, that day we first crossed swords...how you would go on to change my life?
That you'd save my life? That you'd save ALL our lives?!
There are very few times in your life you meet someone who understands you instinctually.
I'd have laughed in your sodding face.
Who gets you almost better than you get yourself.
And I'm not talking about the obvious -Albrecht and the Major and all the rest of that nonsense.
Who knows how to tell you what you need to hear, not what you want to hear.
I'm talking about something much more important. I'm talking about what you've meant to *me.*
What I'm trying to tell you is - thanks for being not just a friend, but being someone I can trust.
Shit. I. Sol above, I don't know how to say this.
Not just to watch my back, not just to join the team, but... someone I can trust with my life.
I think I know what you're going to say. Want me to go first?
You're making me fall asleep over here.
I'm *still* not forgiving you for that spaghetti, though.
That...means a lot, thanks Arthur. And it's mutual.
Yeah, I've just been fooling you this whole time. Sorry.
I think we should just be friends. [Break up.]
I'm sorry it took so long to admit it. But I'm glad you're here. We'd all be dead without you.
I never thought it was possible.
I never thought it was possible.
Not like this. Not in a place like this.
Not like this. Not in a place like this.
And certainly not for someone like me.
And certainly not for someone like me.
And whatever life brings our way?
This was a mistake. We're done.
I know we'll handle it. Together.
Better to end things now than to let things get more complicated.
Time you learned sometimes your sense of humour isn't welcome.
I thought this kind of happiness wasn't possible for me.
If you change your mind, I...I'll be here, love.
I think we should just be friends. [Break up.]
Thank you for showing me I was wrong, love.
